(2) Include the whole word "linen" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "always" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".
